summary: DealLens AI backend tested end-to-end after the new alternatives + analytics feature additions. 15/15 pytest tests passed (100%). Verified: /api/ health, auth guards on 6 protected endpoints (all return 401), POST /api/scan with a real product image (Unsplash watch JPEG, 400x400, ~12KB) → returns full Analysis with alternatives (AI actually produced 3 real, named alternatives with brand/price/currency/reason - Samsung Galaxy Watch FE, Apple Watch SE, Garmin Venu Sq 2), POST /api/scan-text with 'Sony WH-1000XM5' → 3 alternatives (Bose QC Ultra, Sennheiser Momentum 4, AirPods Max), GET /api/scan/{id} + /api/scans include alternatives, POST /api/analytics/event persists to analytics_events, GET /api/analytics/stats returns total_scans/avg_deal_score/best_deal_score/top_category with correct types. MongoDB persistence verified for both scans (with alternatives sub-doc) and analytics_events collections. All TEST_ data cleaned up (0 residual users/sessions/scans/events).

minor.issue: Missing event_type returns 422 (FastAPI validation). Acceptable but no custom message; not user-facing on mobile so low priority.
Uses `language: str` as query param (not JSON body) — inconsistent with rest of the API which takes JSON. Not in scope of this iteration but flagging.

action_items: No blocking issues. Alternatives feature is fully functional across image + text scans. Analytics endpoints are working and persisting correctly.
Optional: consider changing POST /api/auth/language to accept JSON body (consistency).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 677 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, scans.py, analytics.py, ai.py) before further growth.

AI JSON parsing in analyze_text_with_ai lacks the JSONDecodeError fallback that analyze_product_with_ai has — a malformed AI response will 500 instead of returning a graceful default. Recommend mirroring the fallback.

AsyncIOMotorClient created at module import time with sync os.environ lookup — fine but note that DB_NAME has a default fallback ('test_database'); per system rules, env fallbacks should be omitted to fail fast.
gpt-5.4 model string hard-coded twice — extract to a constant/env var.
auth/language accepts arbitrary language string with no whitelist validation — a client could store any value.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ user + session per test run via pymongo; all cleaned up in fixture teardown. Verified 0 residual TEST_ documents after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_deallens_backend.py. IMPORTANT: pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, which splits test classes across two workers — session-scoped fixtures then diverge per worker and TestAnalytics.test_stats fails because it can't see scans created by the other worker. Run with `-n 0` for correct results. Real product JPEG lives at /tmp/product.jpg. AI calls (gpt-5.4 via emergentintegrations) take ~2-4s each; use 120s timeout. Alternatives always returned 3/3 in observed runs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. Prior /api/scan bug (query param → JSON body) is confirmed fixed: ScanRequest is a Pydantic model taken from the JSON body.
